findings.title: Header and footer tap targets below 44px
findings.detail: Measured on iPhone 17 after the registration age gate: brand link height 17px; English/Español language controls height 25px; Manifesto and Contact 15px. Footer legal links 15–16px. WCAG 2.2 target-size minimum is 24px; recommended mobile tap target remains 44px. Primary CTAs (Begin your Journey, Create account, Contact, Sign in) measured 48–50px and pass. Text inputs are 16px/50px and avoid iOS input-zoom.

findings.title: Age-gate radios and consent checkboxes are 16×16 visual boxes
findings.detail: bh-age-eligible radios and registration consent checkboxes render at 16×16. Associated labels likely enlarge the hit area; Row 187 should confirm label wrapping on real iPhone/Android and enlarge if the label does not cover 44px.

findings.title: Inline Sign in and legal document links are 18px tall
findings.detail: Register page 'Already have an account? Sign in' measured 18×204. Inline legal links inside acknowledgments (Privacy Policy, Participant Agreement, AI Disclosure) are 18px tall. Not launch-blocking; fix with Row 187 touch pass.

findings.title: iPhone SE landscape hero nav collides with hero copy
findings.detail: On iPhone SE / 16e compact landscape (667×375) the absolute .bh-hero-nav wraps brand, language switcher, and Manifesto/Contact onto multiple rows and visually overlaps the hero eyebrow/headline cluster. Pixel 10 landscape (915×412) and iPhone 17 portrait did not show the same collision. Row 187 should tighten compact-landscape hero nav (single row or collapse) so 375px-tall viewports stay readable.

findings.title: Native Safari and physical devices were not available
findings.detail: Chromium 148 with iOS Safari 18.6 / Chrome iOS / Chrome Android user-agents and current iPhone 17 / Galaxy S26 / Pixel 10 CSS viewports.
